# Contract fixtures

These bytes are the compiler's output and are owned by the `glyphcull-compiler`
repository. This runtime repo commits independent copies for reader contract
tests: the reader must parse them byte-exactly and reproduce the compiler's
`cull inspect` diagnostics.

| File                   | Provenance                                                                                                             | Purpose                                                                                     |
| ---------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `v1-minimal.cull`      | `glyphcull-compiler/tests/fixtures/v1-minimal.cull` (INFO-only, generated by `glyphcull-format`'s golden_minimal test) | Known-answer container test; truncation corpus base                                         |
| `pipeline-golden.cull` | `glyphcull-compiler/crates/glyphcull-pipeline/tests/fixtures/golden.cull`                                              | Full pipeline golden: 22 chunks, 11 styles, 12 content, 3 atlases, 1 link_target extra, SEAL |
| `golden.md`            | `glyphcull-compiler/crates/glyphcull-pipeline/tests/fixtures/golden.md`                                                | Source document that compiles to `pipeline-golden.cull` (used by later layout phases)        |

The pinned diagnostics live in `tests/common/mod.rs` (`GOLDEN`), mirroring the
JS runtime's `test/testkit/fixtures.ts`.

## Refreshing

`scripts/refresh-fixtures.sh` copies from a checkout of the compiler repo
(override the location with `GLYPHCULL_COMPILER`). Refresh only when the
compiler's golden fixtures deliberately change, and review the diff — the
reader tests pin the exact bytes.
